hashConvention.source: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; no trimming.
hashConvention.declaration: Exact Tree-sitter declaration byte span, excluding preceding XML comments and trailing whitespace.
hashConvention.signature: Declaration start through block, arrow-expression or accessor-list start, with trailing whitespace removed.
hashConvention.body: Exact block, arrow-expression clause or accessor-list bytes.

scope: All callable declarations in the changed directory source. Resource bounds concern name resolution; existing whole-payload reads and decoder behavior are delegated. No broader filesystem, archive or texture-cache acceptance.

variables.L: Requested path characters, at most 32,767 for admitted requests.
variables.D: Non-dot path segments, bounded by L.
variables.K: Per-request processed-entry budget; default 65,536, shared by primary and alternate.
variables.B: Selected payload bytes; not bounded by this lookup change.

declarations.name: NifTextureDirectorySource
declarations.spaceBound: O(R) retained canonical root plus two scalar limits.
declarations.review: Rejects a negative budget. Default K=65,536; no directory enumeration or payload read occurs in construction.

declarations.name: TryLoad
declarations.timeBound: O(L + D filesystem metadata operations + sum of observed entry-path/name lengths); at most K processed entries plus one extra iterator yield, across the request and optional fallback. At most two whole-file reads and existing decoder calls.
declarations.spaceBound: Lookup storage plus existing payload byte arrays and decoder outputs/workspace. No new byte-size cap.
declarations.review: Shares the entry budget between primary and DDS/DDX alternate; refused primary lookup stops fallback, while primary read/decode failure retains alternate behavior.

declarations.name: Exists
declarations.timeBound: O(L + D filesystem metadata operations + sum of observed entry-path/name lengths); at most K processed entries plus one extra iterator yield, across the request and optional fallback.
declarations.spaceBound: O(L + R + F) live helper strings/references, excluding filesystem iterator internals and deferred GC; cumulative temporary entry-path string allocation is proportional to observed path lengths. No retained index.
declarations.review: Checks primary then allowed alternate under the same budget; it does not decode or prove file readability.

declarations.name: TryLoadRaw
declarations.timeBound: O(L + D filesystem metadata operations + sum of observed entry-path/name lengths); at most K processed entries plus one extra iterator yield, across the request and optional fallback. Plus O(B) whole-file read.
declarations.spaceBound: O(L + R + F) live helper strings/references, excluding filesystem iterator internals and deferred GC; cumulative temporary entry-path string allocation is proportional to observed path lengths. No retained index. Plus O(B) returned byte array.
declarations.review: Uses only the requested extension. Lookup entry limits do not bound B. Existing read failure returns null.

declarations.name: TryGetAssetMetadata
declarations.timeBound: O(L + D filesystem metadata operations + sum of observed entry-path/name lengths); at most K processed entries plus one extra iterator yield, across the request and optional fallback. Plus a final filesystem metadata read.
declarations.spaceBound: O(L + R + F) live helper strings/references, excluding filesystem iterator internals and deferred GC; cumulative temporary entry-path string allocation is proportional to observed path lengths. No retained index. Plus metadata/path object storage.
declarations.review: Uses only the requested extension and preserves actual physical spelling, length and last-write ticks. This is not an atomic content snapshot.

declarations.name: Dispose
declarations.review: No index, handle or decoded texture is retained.

declarations.name: AlternatePath
declarations.timeBound: O(L) when constructing the replacement extension.
declarations.review: Only .dds and .ddx are alternates; comparison is ordinal-insensitive.

declarations.name: TryDecodeFile
declarations.timeBound: O(B) read plus delegated decoder time.
declarations.spaceBound: O(B) source array plus delegated decoder allocations/output.
declarations.review: No new input-byte or decoded-size admission. At most one decode per invocation; existing catch-and-null fallback semantics remain.

declarations.name: ResolveLocalPath
declarations.timeBound: O(L + D filesystem metadata operations + sum of observed entry-path/name lengths); at most K processed entries plus one extra iterator yield, across the request and optional fallback.
declarations.spaceBound: O(L + R + F) live helper strings/references, excluding filesystem iterator internals and deferred GC; cumulative temporary entry-path string allocation is proportional to observed path lengths. No retained index.
declarations.review: Validates root-relative scope, length <=32,767 and no parent segments. Each segment requires one unique OrdinalIgnoreCase sibling after complete enumeration. Duplicate aliases refuse even an exact spelling. Enumerator disposal follows foreach exits. The zero-budget check occurs after MoveNext, allowing one extra yielded entry. Links remain followed; this is lookup scope, not a filesystem sandbox.

resourceBounds.enumeration: At most K processed sibling entries and one additional iterator yield. Empty-directory and metadata operations depend on D. No recursive traversal or persistent cache.
resourceBounds.allocation: Streaming lookup retains no collection of siblings, but enumeration allocates path strings; the budget is not a process-memory ceiling.
resourceBounds.payload: TryLoadRaw and TryDecodeFile still read complete files; decoder costs remain unchanged and unbounded by K.
resourceBounds.lifetime: Requests are synchronous, open no retained handles and add no cancellation. Symlink/junction behavior is preserved. Filesystem races between enumeration, metadata and read are not eliminated.
